messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-eu-prod alert=5xx_spike severity=high incident=INC-2026-045 link=https://pagerduty.com/INC-2026-045 runbook=https://confluence.internal/runbooks/inference-eu-5xx
ops-oncall: pinging on-call — @sam are you able to take? seeing multiple PD pages in the last 2m :rotating_light:
sam: taking it. hopping in. starting triage now.
maya: seeing customer reports of 500s in eu-west-1 from SRE monitoring. Any obvious console errors?
sam: pulling logs from inference runtime. quick snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T14:12:02Z] inference-runtime ERROR: kernel launch failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-14T14:12:05Z] worker-7 WARN: request queue backlog increased, avg latency 1.8s
```
Looks like memory pressure on some pods.
jonathan: I rolled a config tweak ~7m ago (quantize-profile v2.3) that touches model caching — rolling that back now.
sam: initiating rollback: `infractl rollback deployment inference-eu-prod --to v2.2` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-eu-prod` — ETA 2-4 min for pods to stabilize.
pagerduty: User sam acknowledged the incident (automated).
lee: while rollback happens, can we apply a routing policy to steer large requests to the smaller model variant? we should reduce OOM risk for big prefixes.
sam: applied temporary routing rule. snippet:
```
routes:
  - match: request.tokens > 512
    route_to: model-rtd-small
    ttl: 15m
```
Policy pushed to edge; metrics should reflect within 30s.
priya: customer-impact check: error-rate across EU is ~7% over last 5m, biggest impact on customers with ID prefix CUST-9 (transactional APIs). posting to status page now: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-045
maya: good. next update in 10m or sooner if status changes. please note ETA for rollback.
jonathan: rollback progress: 40% pods at v2.2, initial logs show fewer cuda OOMs — errors trending down.
sam: confirmed 5xx dropped to ~2.1% after routing change + rollback in progress. still above baseline though. keeping PD ack. if not recovered to <1% in 15m, escalate to SRE lead @lee.
lee: acknowledged. bumping autoscaler minReplicas to 6 as a precaution — applying now.
incident-bot: Note: scheduled handoff to night oncall @zara at 03:00 UTC if incident still open.
zara: thanks — i'll be ready to take the handoff and continue triage if needed.
sam: rollback finished at +7m. error-rate ~0.6% now, latency stable. routing rule will remain for 10m then we will revert. silenced related Prometheus alert group: alertname=Inference5xxHigh (manual).
priya: updating customers that filed tickets: short note added to each with link to status page and mitigation steps.
maya: thanks team. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and the runbook check. I'll schedule a quick RCA sync tomorrow.
sam: final note — probable root cause: quantization/cache change increased memory footprint for some GPU kernels under specific token-size distribution. recommend postmortem to include model config gating and pre-deploy OOM smoke tests.
lee: agreed. I'll add to infra backlog: add preflight job that runs a small synthetic KV cache stress test against inference runtime.
priya: closing updates in 30m if no regressions. thanks everyone. :heart:
